_comment: Apps listed in gitLinked are deployed by Netlify itself (linked to this repo). Every other folder in apps/ with a netlify.toml gets its own site, created and deployed by .github/workflows/netlify-apps.yml. The site name is names[folder] if set, else the folder name + "2"; if that name is taken the workflow stops instead of inventing one, so check availability and choose a name before adding an app.
